data.description: Live Royal, Invest Smart – Luxury, Comfort, and Connectivity in One Address.

data.answer:
Royal Estates Dubai is a gated residential development in Dubai Investments Park (DIP), offering a blend of modern architecture and premium living. Designed for urban residents who appreciate style and comfort, the community features contemporary apartments and townhouses with elegant finishes. Dubai Royal Estates ensures a secure and peaceful environment while providing easy access to major business hubs and leisure destinations.

The community is thoughtfully designed with open green spaces, landscaped parks, and a beautiful crystal-clear lagoon. Residents can enjoy a range of amenities, including swimming pools, fitness centers, kids' play areas, and barbecue spots. Restaurants, cafés, and retail outlets add to the convenience, making everyday life more enjoyable.
Dubai Royal Estates redefines cosmopolitan living with its seamless integration of luxury, nature, and community-focused design. With its exceptional facilities and well-connected location, it is an excellent choice for families, professionals, and investors seeking a refined lifestyle in Dubai.

Royal Estates Dubai offers a diverse selection of residential and commercial properties, catering to a range of lifestyles. From stylish apartments to spacious townhouses, the community provides high-end living in a well-planned environment.

Popular Buildings in Dubai Royal Estates

Dubai Royal Estates features modern residential buildings that house 1,200 apartments, available in studio, one-bedroom, and three-bedroom duplex layouts. These apartments are designed with contemporary interiors and open floor plans, ensuring comfort and functionality. 

The development also includes premium office suites as part of Phase 1, making it an ideal choice for businesses seeking a well-connected workspace. With cafes, shops, and dining options set amid lush greenery, the community promotes a tranquil yet vibrant lifestyle.

Off-Plan Projects in Royal Estates

Royal Real Estate Dubai continues to expand, with several off-plan projects in the pipeline. These projects focus on luxury townhouses and apartments, designed to offer modern features and high-end finishes. 

The upcoming phases include additional residential towers and commercial spaces, further enhancing the appeal of this dynamic community. Investors looking for promising opportunities can explore off-plan options that provide flexible payment plans and potential capital appreciation.

Renting a Property in Royal Estates

Renting in Royal Estates Dubai is an excellent option for those seeking a premium lifestyle at competitive rates. The community offers a range of rental options, from stylish apartments to spacious townhouses, catering to professionals, families, and entrepreneurs. 

With well-maintained facilities, landscaped surroundings, and easy access to major highways, renting in this community ensures convenience and comfort. The presence of office spaces and retail outlets adds to its attractiveness, making it a well-rounded living destination.

Buying a Property in Royal Estates

Buying a property in Dubai Royal Estates is a lucrative investment, given its prime location in Dubai Investments Park. The development includes 400 townhouses in two, three, and five-bedroom configurations, built in phases with sleek glass-front designs. 

These townhouses, along with the apartments and commercial spaces, offer long-term value for end-users and investors. With an array of amenities, scenic surroundings, and future development plans, Royal Estates Dubai remains a sought-after choice for property buyers.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Dubai Royal Estates?

data.answer:
With lush green spaces, modern amenities, and well-designed homes, the community provides an upscale lifestyle in a well-connected location.

Transportation and Parking Spaces in Royal Estates

Residents enjoy the convenience of dedicated parking spaces, ensuring hassle-free vehicle access. Visitors can easily find parking along the well-planned streets within the community.

Getting around is effortless, thanks to a well-connected public transport network near Dubai Royal Estates. Bus routes F46 and F47 operate from multiple nearby stops, including Dubai Lagoon 1, Dubai Lagoon 2, and Ewan Residence, all within a short 3 to 8-minute drive. For metro access, Al Furjan Metro Station is the closest option, located just 13 minutes away.

Supermarkets in and Around Royal Estates

Grocery shopping is effortless for residents of Royal Estates Dubai, with several well-stocked supermarkets nearby. Whether it's fresh produce, daily essentials, or specialty items, there are plenty of options within easy reach.

Souk Extra at Ewan Residence houses Spinneys and Almaya Supermarket, offering a premium selection of goods. For added convenience, residents can also shop at Carrefour Market, AM Abdul Waheed Supermarket, Afsha Mini Mart, and Choithrams DIP, all located just a short drive away.

Shopping Mall Near Royal Estates

A variety of shopping destinations are located just minutes away, offering everything from daily essentials to retail indulgence. Whether you're looking for groceries, fashion, or home essentials, several malls cater to every need.
DIP Mall, near Exchange in Dubai Investments Park 2, is a convenient choice for quick errands. OSR Mall and Crystal Mall in Mina Jebel Ali feature a mix of retail outlets and essential services. For a broader selection, Ramla Mall provides diverse shopping options in a well-organized setting.

For those who enjoy a relaxed shopping experience, The Market in Green Community Village is an ideal spot. With a supermarket, pharmacy, restaurants, banks, bookshops, and salons, it offers a stress-free alternative to busier malls, making everyday shopping effortless.

Schools and Nurseries in and Near Royal Estates

Education is a top priority in Royal Estates Dubai, with several reputable schools located nearby. Families have access to quality institutions offering international curricula, ensuring a well-rounded academic experience for students of all ages.

The International School of Choueifat DIP, part of the renowned SABIS Group, has been providing co-educational learning since 2012. It offers a structured curriculum from Kindergarten to Grade 12, focusing on academic excellence and skill development.

Another excellent option is Greenfield International School, established in 2007 by Taaleem. This IB-accredited institution follows a globally recognized curriculum, catering to students from early years to high school. For younger children, Noah School offers a nurturing learning environment within close proximity.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques Near Royal Estates

Faith and spirituality are well accommodated in and around the neighborhood, with several mosques and churches located nearby. Worshippers have easy access to religious centers within minutes from the community.

Zulikha Al Homidi Mosque is the closest option, just a 4-minute drive away. Other mosques in the vicinity include Qilar Juma Masjid, Masjid Abdul Razak Allana Mosque, Al Taqwa Masjid, and Masjid Tayyab Mohammed Ibrahim, all offering convenient spaces for prayer and congregation.

For Christian residents, Hope Church in DIP is also a 4-minute drive away. A wider selection of churches can be found in Jebel Ali Village, around 13 minutes by car. These include Dubai Evangelical Church Centre, United Christian Church of Dubai, St. Francis of Assisi Catholic Church, The Filipino Christian Church of Dubai, Dubai Mar Thoma Church, Covenant Hope Church, The African Apostolic Church, and St. Gregorios Orthodox Church, Jebel Ali.

Clinics and Hospitals Near Royal Estates

From routine check-ups to specialized treatments, medical facilities are within easy reach.
Right Health Karama Medical Centre and Right Health Al Azhar Clinic Branch provide essential healthcare services, including general consultations and diagnostics. Access Clinic offers affordable medical care, ensuring residents have quick access to treatment when needed.

For more advanced medical needs, GMCClinics in Green Community offers a range of specialized healthcare services. NMC Royal Hospital, DIP, is the closest full-service hospital, equipped with state-of-the-art facilities and a team of experienced medical professionals.

Location & Nearby Areas

Royal Estates enjoys a prime location in Dubai Investments Park (DIP), surrounded by well-developed residential and commercial communities. Its strategic position offers residents easy access to key areas while maintaining a peaceful and secure living environment.

Several established sub-communities are located nearby, including Green Community East, Green Community West, and Dubai Investments Park Phase 1 and Phase 2. These areas provide additional amenities, shopping destinations, and business hubs, making daily life more convenient.

For those looking for leisure and entertainment, Jumeirah Golf Estates is just a 19-minute drive away, offering world-class golfing facilities and scenic landscapes. Dubai Production City, formerly known as The International Media Production Zone, is an 11-minute drive, while Jebel Ali Industrial Area is just 10 minutes away, providing further business and employment opportunities.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Royal Estates, Dubai

data.answer:
Residents of this gated community have plenty of ways to unwind, from enjoying lush green spaces to exploring nearby shopping and dining options. With easy access to entertainment hubs and leisure facilities, there’s always something to do.

Restaurants

A diverse selection of dining options is available just minutes away, offering everything from casual cafés to international cuisine. Whether craving quick bites or a full-course meal, there’s something for every taste.
Popular choices include Juicy Land Cafeteria, Doner & Gyros – DIP, and Royal Grill Restaurant, known for their flavorful dishes. For those who enjoy Middle Eastern and Turkish cuisine, Emir Turkish Restaurant and Arabian Grill Restaurant are excellent options.

Other nearby eateries include Nour Al Madar, Appam Corner Restaurant, Entey Nalukettu Restaurant – DIP, Wadi Al-Karaz Café & Restaurant, and Mama’esh in Green Community West. For a familiar option, Pizza Hut is also conveniently located for quick and easy dining.

Hotels Around Royal Estates

Premier Inn Hotel is one of the closest options, known for its comfortable rooms, excellent service, and modern amenities. Ideal for both short-term and extended stays, it provides a relaxed atmosphere with dining facilities and fitness services.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness and Beauty

A well-balanced lifestyle is easy to maintain with plenty of outdoor spaces, fitness centers, and beauty salons nearby. Whether it's a relaxing stroll in the park, an intense workout session, or a self-care day, there’s something for everyone.

For those who enjoy the outdoors, Ewan Child Park, DIP Public Park, Green Community Park, and GC East Park provide open green spaces perfect for family outings, jogging, and recreational activities. These parks offer a peaceful retreat within the city, making them ideal for relaxation and leisure.

Fitness enthusiasts have several gyms to choose from, including Atlas Power Gym, Evolve Fitness, Ritaj Gym, Fitness Founders, and Hybrid Gym. Each facility offers modern equipment, professional trainers, and a variety of workout programs to suit different fitness levels.

For beauty and self-care, a range of salons and spas are located nearby. Heydi Ladies Salon in Souq Extra and Caractere Ladies Salon in Carrefour Market cater to women’s grooming needs, while Spring Dale Gents Salon in Dubai Investment Park 1 offers specialized services for men. Additional options like Angelique Ladies Salon and Barber Comb and Scissors Gents Salon ensure that residents have access to top-tier beauty and wellness treatments.

Community Events

A vibrant sense of community is fostered through social gatherings and events held throughout the year. Ritaj Community Centre is a popular venue that organizes various activities, providing residents with opportunities to connect, network, and unwind. These events range from family-friendly festivals to cultural celebrations, creating a lively and engaging atmosphere for all ages.

Attractions and Landmarks

Al Maktoum International Airport is conveniently located 22 minutes away via Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311), making travel seamless for frequent flyers. Jebel Ali Village, known for its cultural heritage and residential charm, is only a 13-minute drive via D57.

For shopping and entertainment, Ibn Battuta Mall is just 16 minutes away, offering a variety of retail outlets, dining options, and entertainment venues. Those looking for a vibrant waterfront experience can head to Dubai Marina, which is only a 22-minute drive via D57, featuring stunning views, lively nightlife, and a range of leisure activities.

This community offers a well-balanced lifestyle with modern residences, green spaces, and excellent amenities. Its strategic location ensures seamless connectivity to key areas, making daily commutes convenient.

With a variety of nearby shopping malls, schools, healthcare facilities, and recreational spots, everything residents need is within easy reach. The presence of parks, fitness centers, and dining options further enhances the appeal of this vibrant neighborhood. Whether for families, professionals, or investors, the community provides a comfortable and well-connected living experience.

What types of properties are available in Royal Estates?

Royal Estates offers a variety of residential options, including studios, one to three-bedroom apartments, and two to five-bedroom townhouses. The community also features office spaces and a luxury hotel. 

Who developed Royal Estates?

The project is a collaboration between Aristocrat Star Real Estate Development and Texture Holdings, with architectural designs by Tony Ashai and interiors by Gauri Khan. The development is endorsed by Bollywood actor Shah Rukh Khan. 

What amenities are available within the community?

Residents can enjoy landscaped parks, picnic lawns with barbecue areas, a crystal-clear lagoon, swimming pools, gyms, kids' play areas, and various retail and dining outlets.

Where is Royal Estates located?

Royal Estates is situated within Dubai Investments Park (DIP), providing easy access to major highways and proximity to key areas like Jebel Ali, Dubai Marina, and Al Maktoum International Airport. 

Is Royal Estates a freehold development?

Yes, Royal Estates is a freehold development, allowing both UAE nationals and expatriates to own property within the community. 

What is the status of the Royal Estates project?

The project has been completed, with properties now available for sale and rent.
Explore Royal Estates Dubai on the map to see its prime location, nearby amenities, and seamless connectivity to key areas in the city.

data.content:
Royal Estates Dubai is a 2.3 million sq. ft. gated community in Dubai Investments Park (DIP). This mixed-use development offers luxury apartments, spacious townhouses, and premium office spaces. Developed by Texture Holding Ltd., it was launched in October 2008 and completed in June 2018.

 The project is designed by award-winning architect Tony Ashai, with interiors curated by world-class designer Gauri Khan. Adding to its prestige, it is endorsed by Bollywood superstar Shah Rukh Khan. Its prime location near Dubai International Airport and Jebel Ali Free Zone makes it a well-connected and highly desirable address for residents and investors.

The community is surrounded by lush green spaces, a scenic lagoon, and a range of lifestyle amenities. Residents have access to cafés, restaurants, retail shops, and recreational facilities. The secure environment and well-planned infrastructure make it ideal for families and professionals. With a focus on high-end living, the development combines contemporary design with world-class facilities, ensuring a comfortable and stylish lifestyle.
